messages:
carla_g: Morning — quick async check. Three new open models just hit intake (links below). Need volunteers for ownership, a legal/license thumbs-up, and a perf profile request to runtime. Can people claim?

carla_g: Models:```
- auburn-7b  (LLM, 7B, supports causal + chat)
- marigold-2.1b (small convo model, embeddings v2)
- basalt-13b (decoder-only, larger context)
```

carla_g: Main asks: owner (who will shepherd), license check (OSS license type + any export issues), perf bench (p50/p95 on our default infra + embedding vector shape). ETA: aiming to greenlight catalog metadata + perf profiles by EOD next Tue.

liam: I can take auburn-7b owner. Will run quick perf pass today. :eyes:

olga: I'll look at marigold embeddings shape — we had a few shapes break recently.

jenn: I will do the license sweep for all three. FYI if any are AGPL/MPL we need legal review.

catalog-bot: Intake ticket created: CI-824 (auburn-7b), CI-825 (marigold-2.1b), CI-826 (basalt-13b) :white_check_mark:

liam: Quick bench snippet I'm going to run:```bash
runtimectl bench --model auburn-7b --seq 512 --batch 8 --quant int8 --region us-west-2
```

liam: Initial local run on g5.2x: p50 ~ 62ms/token, p95 ~ 180ms/token. Memory looks OK, kv cache stable. Will try a 1k seq run tomorrow for tail latency.

olga: marigold-2.1b embedding output looks like 1536 dims from the model card. Our embeddings service expects 768/1024 variants. Suggest we either: 1) accept 1536 and map into new table, or 2) add transform to project -> 768. Thoughts?

michael: If we accept 1536, cost/storage increases. For now I'd prefer a transform to 768 unless product requires direct parity. Who owns embedding pipeline change?

olga: I can prototype a projection layer (FP32 matmul) as a stopgap. If we keep as-is long term, we'll need to add a new embedding dimension to the indexers.

jenn: License quick notes: auburn-7b -> MIT, marigold-2.1b -> Apache-2.0, basalt-13b -> CLA pending (maintainer response). I'll follow-up on CLA; if no reply within 48h we escalate to legal.

carla_g: Thanks. @liam can you push perf numbers into CI-824 as comment and tag @eng-runtime? @olga please add embed shape notes to CI-825. @jenn add license updates to each ticket.

liam: Done — comment added, pinged @eng-runtime. Also attached ngrok logs for a quick smoke:```
[info] 2026-02-12T09:12:45Z bench start
[info] p50 62ms p95 180ms
[warn] tail spikes at seq=1024, investigating
```

devex-bot: Reminder: perf templates available at https://internal.redwood/devex/perf-guides — use the "model-profile" checklist when you file results.

aisha: For rollout: propose canary window next Tue 10:00 PT -> 14:00 PT. Canary should cover auburn + marigold at 1% traffic with autoscale disabled. If auburn p95 < 220ms we promote. If anything else fails we rollback to baseline.

carla_g: Sounds good. I'll schedule the canary and add the rollout plan to CI-824/825. @olga please also mark whether embedding projection will block canary.

olga: Projection won't block canary for generation-only paths; it will block embedding-indexing for product tests. I'll try to push a prototype by EOD Friday.

michael: Quick CR ping — I left a few comments on liam's runtime bench PR (small nit re: env flags). If you can address, I can approve today.

liam: noted, fixing now.

jenn: CLA update: maintainer for basalt-13b replied; they require a signed contributor agreement for commercial use. I'll outline options in CI-826.

carla_g: Summary / next steps: 1) liam = auburn owner + perf (bench results in CI-824) 2) olga = marigold owner + embed prototype (CI-825) 3) jenn = license lead (CI-824/5/6) 4) aisha = canary scheduling/rollout ops. Everyone, please add short status to the tickets by EOD Friday. We aim to launch catalog profiles + canary next Tue. :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup:

olga: :thumbsup:

jenn: on it

carla_g: If no blockers, I'll mark this thread resolved tonight. Ping here if anything urgent pops up.
